reason: The 'no effect' conclusion rests on an unjustified north-only subsample, which cuts power by about two thirds, and on a null result that was read as proof of no effect. With the full sample and the full set of pre-period controls, my rerun gives a positive, significant remote_share coefficient of about 0.75 (SE 0.23, p=0.001). The central and south regions are also individually significant, so the report's 'no effect' claim is not robust.
